kinds.semantics: whole consists of part; part cannot exist independently
whole groups parts that can exist independently
active structure performs behaviour, or artefact is deployed on node
element plays a critical role in creating or achieving another
element provides its functionality to another
behaviour observes or acts upon a passive element
transfer from one element to another
element is a particular kind of another

constraints.basis: BIAN Service Landscape structure (public portal)
constraints.description: A business area is composed of business domains.
constraints.reasoning: The Service Landscape is a three-tier grouping: areas contain domains contain Service Domains.

constraints.basis: BIAN Service Landscape structure (public portal)
constraints.description: A business domain is composed of Service Domains.
constraints.reasoning: Second tier of the landscape grouping.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A Service Domain offers its operations in service groups.
constraints.reasoning: The metamodel overview places service groups between the domain and its operations.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A service group contains service operations.
constraints.reasoning: Operations are the leaves of the domain's service structure.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A Service Domain governs one control record.
constraints.reasoning: Every Service Domain has exactly one control record, the thing it manages across its lifecycle.
constraints.reference_source: [SL14] MetaModel Overview; Control Record Model (public portal)

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A Service Domain applies one functional pattern.
constraints.reasoning: The pattern names the generic behaviour the domain performs on its asset.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A Service Domain manages one asset type.
constraints.reasoning: The asset type is the thing the pattern acts on; pattern plus asset define the domain.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview (public portal)
constraints.description: A service operation may be qualified by a behaviour qualifier.
constraints.reasoning: Operations act on a partition of the control record; the qualifier names that partition and appears in the REST path.

constraints.basis: BIAN Business Scenarios (public portal)
constraints.description: A business scenario sequences service operations across domains.
constraints.reasoning: Scenarios are illustrative choreographies of operations; aggregation because operations exist independently.

constraints.basis: BIAN Business Object Model (public portal)
constraints.description: A business object is composed of its attributes.
constraints.reasoning: The BOM defines objects as sets of typed attributes.

constraints.basis: BIAN MetaModel Overview; [SAPG] §3.2.4 (B07)
constraints.description: A control record is partitioned by behaviour qualifiers.
constraints.reasoning: Qualifiers are the sub-structures of the control record that operations address.

constraints.basis: BIAN BOM / Control Record rationalisation, [RN14] §1.3 (B08)
constraints.description: A control record's attributes are typed by business objects.
constraints.reasoning: Control records and the BOM were rationalised together in release 14.

constraints.description: A service operation acts on the control record.
constraints.reasoning: Every operation reads or changes the domain's control record; the action term says how.

constraints.basis: [SAPG] §3.2.6 first-order connections (B12)
constraints.description: A Service Domain connects to other Service Domains.
constraints.reasoning: First-order connections: the domains a domain calls or is called by.

constraints.basis: [SL14] Wireframes Overview; [SAPG] §3.4 — a wireframe depicts a Service Domain (B14)
constraints.description: A wireframe depicts a Service Domain.
constraints.reasoning: Wireframes are published per domain as an illustrative artefact. Not enforceable: artefact entities are never instantiated in a level export (LevelGraph rejects them), so the row records provenance only.

constraints.basis: [APIP]; [SAPG] §3.5 — the Semantic API is derived from the Service Domain's operations (B15)
constraints.description: A Semantic API is derived from a Service Domain.
constraints.reasoning: The reference API is the domain's operations in REST form. Not enforceable: artefact entities are never instantiated in a level export (LevelGraph rejects them), so the row records provenance only.

constraints.basis: [SL14] BOM Overview — the versioned Business Object Model artefact aggregates the business objects (content of B08's source)
constraints.description: The versioned Business Object Model artefact aggregates the business objects.
constraints.reasoning: The BOM release is the container of the objects that type control records; SDMM reading of the BOM overview, not a published BIAN relationship. Not enforceable: artefact entities are never instantiated in a level export (LevelGraph rejects them), so the row records provenance only.
